name: knox-streams
description: Knox Streams — a Stremio addon that aggregates every scraper provider in this repo, and remains a drop-in Nuvio/Fire TV provider pack. Includes a web-based control centre for configuration and provider management. Zero scraping dependencies: HTML parsing and HMAC signing are hand-rolled (see lib/) instead of pulling in cheerio or crypto-js.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && for f in src/*.js routes/*.js lib/*.js providers/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
